evidence.field: sources/baxter-sagart/baxtersagart.tsv, exact rows for 占 and 立; no exact 站 row (provided local_primary_readings)
evidence.text: The local Baxter–Sagart 2014 table gives 占: zhān, Middle Chinese tsyem, Old Chinese *tem, ‘prognosticate’; and 立: lì, Middle Chinese lip, Old Chinese *k.rəp, ‘stand (v.)’. No exact 站 row is present, so this dataset supplies no same-system reconstruction comparison for the proposed 占–站 phonetic relationship. Do not merge these readings with Zhengzhang values.
evidence.title: The Baxter-Sagart reconstruction of Old Chinese (landing page inspected; exact rows checked locally)

evidence.source: Ministry of Education, R.O.C., Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.field: 站 entry, explanation and historical witnesses
evidence.text: The entry says 站 is not recorded in Shuowen; it gives the graphic analysis as left 立 and right 占, records the reading zhàn, and lists medieval dictionary witnesses including Longkan Shoujing, Guangyun, and Jiyun. It defines standing senses and a travel stop or transfer station sense, citing 元史 for the latter. This establishes reported lexicographic senses, not a dated first spoken use or a sequence of graphic changes.
evidence.title: [A02978] 站 - Ministry of Education Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants

evidence.field: File description and license for 立-seal.svg
evidence.text: The file page describes the image as 立 in Shuowen seal-script style and identifies a source image reference at hanziyuan.net. The page states public-domain terms for the SVG representation. This is a component illustration, not an early form of 站; its depicted script style cannot establish 站’s graphic history.
evidence.title: File:立-seal.svg - Wikimedia Commons

evidence.field: 站, 字源 and 詞源 sections
evidence.text: This secondary page analyzes 站 as semantic 立 plus phonetic 占 and lists Zhengzhang Shangfang (2003) Old Chinese readings 站 *rteːms and 占 *ʔljem, *tjems. Separately, it reports a ninth–tenth-century Northern Chinese word and competing accounts linking the post-station word with Mongolian ǰamči/ǰam or reversing the borrowing direction. The page gives no inspected dated primary citation for the ninth–tenth-century claim; the borrowing proposal remains disputed.
evidence.title: 站 - 维基词典，自由的多语言词典

evidence.text: The search result surfaced the CNS11643 character page for 占 and showed Mandarin zhàn among the listed readings. The page could not be opened for direct inspection, so it is not used as verified character-specific evidence.
evidence.title: 字形資訊 - [占] 1-4627 - 全字庫 CNS11643

search_audit.query: 站 站字 广韵 俗言独立 站赤 元史 字源 立 占
search_audit.outcome: Opened the Chinese Wiktionary, Taiwan MOE dictionary, and the 立 seal-file page. 站 and 占 Unihan endpoints failed. The 占 seal-file page failed to open. The MOE page supports the component analysis, lexicographic standing and station senses, and cited source witnesses; Wiktionary separately reports the phonetic-series account and disputed loan proposals.

search_audit.query: Unicode Unihan U+5360 kMandarin zhàn 占; Unicode Unihan U+7AD9 kMandarin zhàn 站
search_audit.outcome: Search results reported 占 and 站 as zhàn on third-party or CNS11643 pages; direct CNS11643 and Unicode pages failed to open. These search results are not treated as directly inspected official Unihan records. Local exact rows confirm the readings.

search_audit.query: 占-seal.svg Wikimedia Commons 立-seal.svg historical seal script source
search_audit.outcome: Opened the 立 seal file page and inspected its identity, stated source, script label, and license. The 占 page returned a cache error; neither file is evidence of a historical 站 glyph.

gaps: No early glyph sequence for 站 was inspected. The MOE analysis supports its visible 立-plus-占 structure, but graphic evolution, corruption, or earlier forms remain undocumented.
The first attested date for the standing sense and the word itself remains unresolved. Wiktionary’s ninth–tenth-century claim lacks an inspected dated primary citation in this run.
The MOE entry cites a 元史 passage for the post-station sense, but the exact passage date and a semantic bridge from ‘stand’ to ‘station’ are not established.

The 站赤/Middle Mongol ǰamči and Mongolian ǰam etymology is disputed; the inspected material did not establish early source-word attestations, independently recoverable pronunciations, or borrowing direction.
The local Baxter–Sagart table has 占 *tem but no 站 row. Zhengzhang *rteːms and *tjems are a distinct reconstruction system and cannot substitute for the missing Baxter–Sagart comparison.
Official Unihan pages for U+7AD9 and U+5360 could not be inspected. Exact local kMandarin rows are 占 zhàn, 立 lì, and 站 zhàn; these are current metadata, not evidence for an ancient phonetic relation.

The Commons 立-seal.svg page verifies a Shuowen seal-style component image and public-domain status, but it does not illustrate 站. The 占 file page was inaccessible, and no 站 historical glyph asset was verified.
